name: Toudou Takamichi
source: The hero of the story, the average boy who deeply cares about his little sister Kana. During childhood he didn't like Kana due to the attention she got from their parents but after an incident started supporting her, even more than a real brother. He is always there for her when she needs him. Later in the game he becomes confused about his feelings for Kana.
